result.summary: The page looks mostly intact, but a couple of content areas are visually clipped. The most noticeable issue is that the next restaurant card at the bottom is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation bar, and the horizontal row near the top is cut off at the right edge.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card is partially obscured by the fixed bottom navigation bar, making the content look cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add extra bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content so cards are fully visible above the navigation bar.

issues.description: The horizontal restaurant carousel near the top is clipped at the right edge, with part of the next card only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Increase horizontal spacing or clearly indicate the row is scrollable so the clipped card looks intentional.
